capabilities: Open a folder as an image gallery in a new tab
Collect images embedded or linked in the folder's notes
Hide file names and note links for an images-only grid
Enlarge thumbnails and open the notes that use an image
extras: Reads up to 800 notes and shows up to 600 images; notes larger than 1.5 MB are not scanned for image links. Makes no network requests. On phones the gallery may only be openable from the command, not the file explorer menu.
problem: The file explorer lists images as plain files, so there is no way to browse a folder's pictures, including ones only referenced from notes, as a visual grid.
summary: Gallery view that shows a folder's image files together with images embedded or linked from that folder's notes, in a new tab.
